icons.name: download
icons.heading: Download
icons.description: A download lands. Light: the arrow drives down into the tray and stops dead; the tray takes the knock, rebounds and settles, and a content line draws out from the middle of the tray where the arrow lands. The spent arrow fades and a fresh one drops in from above to its rest pose, and the line fades as it settles. Strong: a short wind-up, a harder drive, a bigger knock that rebounds twice, and the line snaps out.

icons.name: unlink
icons.heading: Unlink
icons.description: The link breaks. Light: the two halves of the chain slide together along their axis until they hook into each other like a link, then snap apart past their place with a jolt, rebound and settle; the break marks burst out on both sides of the gap as they part. Strong: they hook together and tug once against each other, then tear apart harder, overshoot farther and settle in two beats, and the break marks burst out wider. The halves are rigid; they only slide along their shared axis.

Strong: a double tap, two quick presses, the second deeper, each sending a ring out wider.

icons.name: swipe
icons.heading: Swipe
icons.description: A finger swipes across the screen. Light: the hand eases back a touch, then swipes left under the arrow, runs a little past and settles; the arrow's left head kicks out as the finger reaches it, and the hand glides back to the middle. Strong: the hand swipes left and then all the way right, each head kicking out in turn as the finger reaches it, before the hand settles back in the middle.
